name: Arlecchino
title: Dire Balemoon
description: The 'Father' of the House of the Hearth, the Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A quiet, composed diplomat who is ruthless in duty.

talents.name: Invitation to a Beheading
talents.description: Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes. When Arlecchino has a Bond of Life equal to or greater than 30% of her Max HP, she enters the 'Masque of the Red Death' state, converting her Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks to Pyro DMG that cannot be overridden.

talents.name: All is Ash
talents.description: Summons forth Balemoon Bloodfire, dealing Pyro DMG to multiple nearby opponents and performing a dash-cleave attack. Opponents hit receive a Blood-Debt Directive.

talents.name: Balemoon Rising
talents.description: Arlecchino unfurls her great wing of Balemoon Bloodfire, recovering Bond of Life and dealing AoE Pyro DMG while resetting the cooldown of All is Ash and healing herself based on her Bond of Life and ATK.

talents.name: The Balemoon Alone May Know
talents.description: Defeating an opponent with a Blood-Debt Directive grants Arlecchino a Bond of Life equal to 130% of her Max HP. 5s after a Directive is applied, it upgrades to a Due Directive granting 130% Max HP Bond of Life when absorbed.

talents.name: Agony Alone May Be Repaid
talents.description: Arlecchino gains 1% All Elemental and Physical RES for every 100 ATK she possesses beyond 1,000. The maximum RES increase obtainable this way is 20%.

constellations.name: "All Reprisals and Arrears, Are Mine to Bear..."
constellations.description: Masque of the Red Death's value increase is further increased by 100%. In addition, Arlecchino's interruption resistance is increased when she performs Normal or Charged Attacks while in the Masque of the Red Death state.

constellations.name: "All Rewards and Retribution, Mine to Bestow..."
constellations.description: Blood-Debt Directives are now Blood-Debt Due when created. When Arlecchino absorbs a Due Directive, she unleashes Balemoon Bloodfire dealing 900% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG and gaining 20% All Elemental and Physical RES for 15s.

constellations.name: "You Shall Become a New Family..."
constellations.description: Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "You Shall Love and Protect Each Other..."
constellations.description: When Arlecchino successfully absorbs a Blood-Debt Directive, Balemoon Rising's CD is decreased by 2s and 15 Energy is restored to her. This effect can occur once every 10s.

constellations.name: "For We Are As Good As Dead..."
constellations.description: Increases the Level of Balemoon Rising by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "From This Day On, We Shall Delight in New Life."
constellations.description: The DMG of Balemoon Rising is increased by Arlecchino's ATK multiplied by 700% of her current Bond of Life percentage. For 20s after using All is Ash, both Normal Attacks and Balemoon Rising gain 10% CRIT Rate and 70% CRIT DMG.

talents.name: Let the People Rejoice

constellations.name: "Like a Bird Unto the Dawn, So Should Love Cry Out"

constellations.name: "A Woman Adapts to Changes, Like a Duck to Water"
